item.title: Comment on Long service of members by Raymond Lee
item.description: Congratulations to Bruce Pimlott, Steve Freedman, Steve Freeborn and Margaret Gilmour for their long service membership!

item.title: Comment on Pharmacy bodies express anger over exclusion from business rates relief by Arthur Jolley
item.description: I believe that this decision to favor Pubs and Entertainment Venues over Pharmacy premises should be challenged by as many pharmacists as possible by writing to their MPs and or the Newspapers asking why this government would rather see a local Pub kept open rather than a Local Pharmacy. Older patients need their local Pharmacy far more than their local Pub.

item.title: Comment on Higher-dose Wegovy could increase patient expectation, warns PDA by Ghamshyambhai Patidar
item.description: The penultimate paragraph states " Mounjaro (Semiglutide: Eli Lilly)" Is that correct? Should it not read "Mounjaro (Tirzepatide : Eli Lilly" !!!

item.title: Comment on Philip Leon Marshall Davies (1938–2026) by Nicholas Wood
item.description: I was very sorry to hear of the passing of Marshall Davies. Marshall served as President and then Immediate Past President of the Society at a difficult time when Government, in the wake of several scandals, was pressing for the reform of the whole area of governance and regulation in the Health Professions. item.title: Comment on Prescribing pathfinders: what’s stopping community pharmacy delivering care for long-term conditions? by Sidney Burford
